shared_platform_architecture_finding.question: Can Thriv3 safely model hostname/path or institution-specific tenant -> UNITID without weakening the registrable-domain safety model?
shared_platform_architecture_finding.finding: PrestoSports/Sidearm shared platforms recurred as a blocker: schools serve athletics from an institution-specific host (defianceathletics.com) OR a shared-platform tenant subdomain (defiance.prestosports.com whose registrable root prestosports.com serves hundreds of schools). The registrable-domain model correctly refuses the shared root. In every 7B.5D shared case the school ALSO had an institution-specific VERIFIED host, so option (B/C) was unnecessary — the fix was to repoint coach email_source_url from the shared tenant/root (or a Wayback URL) to the institution-specific verified host.

options.A_host_only_registry: Current model. Safe, but cannot represent a school that ONLY has a shared-tenant host (none in Tier-2).
options.B_host_plus_path_tenant: Add tenant/path authority (prestosports.com/<tenant> -> UNITID). More expressive but widens the trust surface and needs per-tenant proof; NOT needed for Tier-2.
options.C_per_programme_institution_link: Store an independent institution->athletics link as per-programme evidence. Cleanest for shared platforms; recommended IF a future division has schools with only a shared-tenant host.

shared_platform_architecture_finding.recommendation: Keep A (host-only registry) for now — no Tier-2 school required B/C. Adopt C (per-programme institution-link evidence) only if NJCAA/USCAA surface schools whose ONLY athletics host is a shared-platform tenant. Do NOT implement in this phase.

prevention_findings.same_name_collision: 6 registry collision domains were name-family false flags or wrong-owner claims (sfuathletics IL vs PA; johnsonroyals Johnson vs Judson; lsugoldeneagles La Sierra vs Sierra College). Prevention: never auto-map a host any other UNITID can credibly claim; require institution-site->athletics-link + host self-id.
prevention_findings.stale_registry_claim: lsugoldeneagles.com carried a false "Sierra"->123341 claim; iuindyjags.com WRONG_INSTITUTION. Prevention: periodically re-adjudicate WRONG_INSTITUTION/AMBIGUOUS rows against live evidence.
prevention_findings.shared_platform: prestosports.com root + tenant subdomains + Wayback source URLs blocked strict corroboration though the email was on the institution host. Prevention: at ingest, prefer the institution-specific host and flag shared-tenant/Wayback source URLs.
prevention_findings.missing_alias_new_host: gofightingsaints.com, viterboathletics.com were the true hosts but unregistered/insufficient. Prevention: a verified-email coach on an unverified source host should trigger an ownership follow-up.
prevention_findings.identity_defect: IU Columbus programme stapled to IU Indy UNITID 151111 (true IPEDS 15111102 absent from colleges); Park University Gilbert branch has no distinct UNITID. Prevention: a college-identity reconciliation pass against IPEDS for branch campuses.
prevention_findings.no_email: UHSP publishes no men's-soccer coach email; Christendom only a generic team inbox. Valid integrity outcomes — never infer.
